products.title: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum was launched in 2010 and was composed by French perfumers Jean-Christophe Hérault and Erwin Creed. It has been formulated multiple times since its release in order to achieve its current balanced and seamless concentration.  
Creed Aventus EDP for men has been chosen as the winner for the prestigious Best Fragrance of the Year—Basenotes Readers’ Awards (2011–2014) and Top 10 Fragrances of All Time—based on the user votes.

products.title: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Lattafa. It is a classy and modern scent with a nice mix of citrus, woods and spice. The perfume opens fresh with lemon, bergamot, clary sage and juniper berries, giving a cool and clean feeling. As it settles, white tea, sandalwood, cardamom and olibanum bring warmth and smoothness. The dry down has ambergris, cedarwood, cashmeran and patchouli that make it deep, cozy, and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a dessert style fragrance profile made with pistachio, ice cream, bergamot, hazelnut, cardamom and rum (top notes); pear, jasmine, peony, geranium, raspberry and white peach (heart notes) and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, tonka bean and cedarwood (base notes) blended softly into a playful and smooth composition with gourmand sweetness and fruity floral touch that feels cozy and addictive.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau De Toilette is a warm, smooth and cozy scent made to feel like a relaxed night in a dim jazz bar. The fragrance is opens with bright and spicy top notes of pink pepper, neroli and lemon that form the opening. It appears then, the middle notes of sweet rum, vetiver and clary sage are mixed. The fragrance then draws to an end with a mixture of tobacco leaf, vanilla bean and styrax, which is soft and warm on the skin.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex fragrance which wash launched in 2022 It is a combination of saffron and jasmine which are its top notes and followed by warm amberwood and ambergris in the middle notes and in the base notes with deep fir resin and cedar. The perfume carries a strong and long- lasting scent profile that makes it a favourite among fragrance lovers who enjoy a powerful yet smooth mix of spicy, woody and amber notes.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is a classy, warm, and spicy fragrance designed for men who love to stand out. This perfume brings together rich woody notes, fresh spices, and smooth amber to create a bold yet inviting scent.

Launched in 2023, Afnan Turathi Brown smells modern but carries a timeless touch. With every spray, you get a burst of fresh spices, warm amber, and smooth vanilla that lasts all day. It’s perfect for men who want to feel confident and elegant, whether it’s for daily wear or special evenings.

If you enjoy strong, warm perfumes that leave a lasting impression wherever you go, Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is worth trying.

products.title: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum is a classy and modern men’s perfume from the house of Ajmal. It is made for men who like clean, elegant and confident scents. The fragrance opens fresh and spicy with neroli and pepper, giving a sharp and bright start. The heart feels smooth and warm with orris root, amber and geranium, which adds softness and depth. The base settles into woody tones of cedar and patchouli, making the scent masculine and long lasting. Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum is perfect for daily wear, office use and evening outings without feeling heavy or loud.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum is the scent of modern confidence. It is a bold, magnetic, and deeply expressive fragrance for the man who is unapologetically himself. This perfume captures a powerful and sophisticated feeling, combining a fresh, spicy kick with a warm heart.

Myslf Le Parfum smells like pure charm and character. It is smooth, inviting, and has a touch of mystery, making it perfect for the man who wants to make a memorable statement without saying a word. A few sprays of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum will boost your confidence and leave an unforgettable impression of modern elegance.

products.title: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and smooth unisex perfume made for people who love a classy yet modern scent. The opening part is bright and fruity due to the juicy scent of apple and bergamot. Then the heart warms us with the spiciness of cinnamon and woody notes, thus giving us depth and comfort. At last, the base composed of musk and vanilla delivers a smooth and creamy finish that is long-lasting, elegant and beautiful all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Atlas Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Atlas Eau de Parfum begins with a powerful sea scent, combined with salt and lemon. The initial spray is extremely refreshing as it is as though you are in front of the ocean when cool wind is blowing against your face. The lemon gives it a slight sharpness and makes it natural and realistic with the salt.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum is a creamy, warm and bold unisex perfume from the house of Lattafa. It has a strong oriental style with sweet spices, deep woods, soft leather and smoky oud. The opening is spicy with cinnamon, cardamom, and bergamot. The heart has saffron, sandalwood, cedar and carnation, giving a warm and creamy feel. The dry down becomes sweet, woody and slightly smoky with oud, vanilla, leather and amber.

products.title: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum is an intense and warm men's fragrance that is characterized by spicy, sweet, and woody notes. The beginning is a very fresh and bold combination of mandarin, lemon, and spicy pepper that is very vigorous. Gradually, the aroma gets softer with delicate blossoms and wood. Eventually, a heavier, warm feeling is produced by the vanilla, tonka bean, and sandalwood in the base. This fragrance emanates power, self-assuredness, and is spot-on for today’s men.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels luxurious and strong but still smooth. It opens with fresh citrus and spicy notes, then slowly moves into a warm heart of amber, patchouli and oud. The dry down is creamy and soft with vanilla, sandalwood and white musk, which stays close to skin and feels very elegant.

products.title: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. It opens with a warm, spicy blend of nutmeg, clove and lemon that feels fresh yet deep. The middle has a soft, creamy touch of milk blended with rose and davana, offering a slightly sweet, smooth texture. The base settles into creamy notes of amber, patchouli, frankincense and labdanum that feel warm, resinous and long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau De Parfum is a warm and creamy unisex fragrance, which is smooth to the touch and a bit sweet. The introduction is a fresh combination of bergamot, orange and soft spices, which createsa bright but warm introduction. Gradually, coconut and ylang ylang blend into a rich and soothing creamy floral heart. The musk and sandalwood foundation gives the skin a rich, warm woody fragrance that lingers in the skin for many hours. This perfume is classy, contemporary and suited to those who like warm oriental perfumes with a smooth twist.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that is fresh, pure, and luminous. It is characterized by an intense citrus opening of lemon, orange, mandarin, and bergamot that is very revitalizing and vigorous. Then, the ginger gives a smooth fresh feel to the orange blossom and light marine notes, which are soft in character. The underlying tea, musk, and amber create a composed and uncomplicated fragrance that is ideal for everyday use and warm days.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bright unisex scent made for people who enjoy clean, fruity and calming smells. It opens with a cool mix of mint, lemon, orange and black currant that feels like a fresh morning breeze near the sea. The heart has a soft blend of apricot, basil, carrot seed and rose, giving it a gentle and natural vibe. The base settles nicely with fig, dates, and ambrette, making the scent warm, smooth and slightly sweet in a simple, easy way.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum stands as a modern, profound interpretation of the legendary Acqua Di Gio collection. It masterfully achieves balance by merging the invigorating freshness of marine notes with the inherent richness of woody undertones, resulting in a fragrance that projects both purity and significant power. 

The opening sequence delivers the bright, airy freshness of marine notes and bergamot, creating an initial impression reminiscent of a clean sea breeze and crisp citrus. This evolves into an aromatic core of rosemary, clary sage, and geranium, which introduces a distinct herbal depth. Finally, the scent anchors itself with warm notes of olibanum and patchouli, providing a grounded, lasting, and deeply masculine trail. Crafted by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this fragrance is built on a foundation of clean, confident, and enduring sophistication, making it an ideal choice for the man who values an effortlessly elegant and timeless scent.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum is a rich and smooth oriental floral scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2025, this perfume feels classy, warm and modern at the same time. It opens with a juicy pear mixed with fresh bergamot and a little spicy ginger, which feels bright and clean. The heart is soft and floral with orange blossom and jasmine, balanced by gentle woody notes. As it dries down, vanilla, musk and amber come together to give a warm, sweet and cozy feel.

products.title: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume from the house of Afnan which was released in 2022. It is built around a fresh and spicy DNA with sparkling citrus, spices and woody accords. The perfume starts with grapefruit, pink pepper, juniper and cardamom, all are the top notes of this perfume. The middle notes are Calabrian bergamot, cedar, nutmeg and jasmine and the final notes are ambergris, apple, musk and patchouli for a deep long-lasting impression. This fragrance is designed as a versatile everyday signature with a balance of fresh energy and warm sensuality.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum for men is a bold, sensual evening scent that mixes fresh bergamot and green bergamot leaf at the start, flows into a powdery heart of iris, aldehydes, clary sage, and orris, then settles into a warm base of tonka bean and cedar. Created by Antoine Maisondieu in 2022, it keeps the classic Code DNA but adds more depth and sensitivity. People in the fragrance world call it the modern king of night scents, strong yet soft, with an amazing blend of notes, top-notch quality, and projection that fills the room just right, sillage that lingers nicely without being too much.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Dahab Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Dahab Eau De Parfum is like liquid gold in a bottle. An elegant and sophisticated unisex fragrance, it perfectly balances fresh fruits, beautiful flowers, and warm woods. The name "Dhahab" means "gold" in Arabic, and this scent truly lives up to its name, offering a rich and luxurious experience.

Wisal Dahab smells classy, modern, and incredibly charming. It's designed for those who appreciate a fragrance that is both noticeable and graceful. A spray of Ajmal Wisal Dahab makes you feel confident and ready for any occasion, wrapping you in a beautiful golden aura of fruit and flowers.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Sheikh Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Sheikh Eau de Parfum consists of a warm and woody scent that is rich, smooth and elegant. This perfume was created in 2024 by House of My Perfumes. The introduction begins with bergamot, mandarin and elemi, which provides a light citrus beginning with a hint of resin. Sandalwood, amber, cedar and patchouli are eventually introduced in the heart, giving it depth and warmth. The olibanum, musk and vanilla form a creamy and faint smoky base in the dry down of the tonka bean, which remains for many hours on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and slightly spicy men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright bergamot and warm ginger, then moves into soft lavender and green violet leaf. The scent finishes with smooth musk, creamy sandalwood and a hint of warm amber.

products.title: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a bold and heavy unisex scent known for its rich, smoky and sweet spicy style. It starts loud with warm cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg and some fruity green apple and pear. Then it melts into a simple heart of patchouli and jasmine. The dry down comes strong with thick tobacco, sweet vanilla, amber, sandalwood, guaiac wood, white musk and vetiver.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and classy fragrance for men who love to feel cool and confident. Inspired by clear blue skies and a fresh breeze, Afnan Supremacy in Heaven brings together citrus and green notes with a smooth woody base.

This fragrance feels like wearing a crisp white shirt on a sunny day, simple yet very sophisticated. With every spray of Afnan Supremacy in Heaven, you get a burst of fresh bergamot and mandarin orange, followed by soothing green tea and black currant. The base of musk and sandalwood keeps it soft, clean, and long-lasting.

Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions when you want to smell fresh, neat, and modern.

products.title: Khadlaj Karus Blu Spice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Karus Blu Spice Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is Citrus Aromatic and a men's perfume. The initial impression is fresh tea and bright bergamot, which is clean and somewhat sharp. Neroli and ginger gradually emerge after a while, providing a warm and smooth feel. Cinnamon is used in the dry down to bring a light spicy sweetness that is clung near skin throughout the hours. It is contemporary, new and assertive masculine.

products.title: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy fragrance for the modern man. The fragrance begins with the very lively and vibrant top notes of tomato leaf, rose and freesia. It then transforms into a floral and woody heart of rose, sandalwood, cedar and jasmine. Finally, it wraps up with a base that provides a rich and warm finish through the combination of leather, oud, musk, oakmoss and amber.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum is a very masculine perfume that is rich, warm, and creamy and at the same time it is classy and bold. Its first impression comes with a spicy aroma of cardamom and saffron which has a mixed taste of sweet and sharp at the same time. Then the cardamom and saffron gradually fade away into a creamy kulfi and a floral heart which is smooth and special. The base composed of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood gives the fragrance a deep and a very long-lasting quality. This perfume is for the self-confident man who is also luxurious and wants to be perfect for extraordinary occasions.

products.title: Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum is a sharp, fresh, and energetic fragrance designed for the modern man who lives life on the go.1 The name "Shiro," meaning white in Japanese, perfectly captures its clean, crisp, and confident vibe. This perfume is an amazing mix of fresh fruits, cool watery notes, and warm woods that makes you feel instantly refreshed and ready to take on the day.

Shiro smells modern yet timeless. It has the energy of a summer morning and the confidence of a sharp suit. It’s the perfect choice for men who want a versatile, high-quality scent that works for every occasion, from the office to a casual day out. A few sprays of Ajmal Shiro will leave you smelling clean, magnetic, and effortlessly stylish.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with a strong mix of cinnamon, cardamom and a little citrus touch of mandarin. After some time, it becomes sweeter with caramel and soft lavender. The base feels deep and rich with amber, woods and vetiver, giving a bold and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Prada L'homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Prada L’Homme Eau De Toilette is an inviting, subtle, and sophisticated scent for men that exudes freshness and class. It starts off with a gentle and bright soft blend of neroli and pepper. Gradually, the heart delivers a creamy iris and light floral note which is very clean and powdery. The warm woodiness from sandalwood, cedar, and patchouli at the base is very intimate and close to skin. This fragrance is contemporary, tranquil, and extremely corporate, thus, it is well suited for daily use.

products.title: Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s fragrance. Launched in 2022, it is a bright aquatic style scent built around citrus and aromatic notes. The opening feels crisp and lively with bergamot, lemon, tangerine and cardamom. The middle brings soft herbal freshness from lavender and cypress. The base of Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum settles into warm amber, giving the scent a smooth finish.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Legacy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Legacy Eau de Parfum is a clean, sharp and confident fresh and powerful men's fragrance. The initial spray is a fresh burst of citrus with a twist of lime and grapefruit, combined with cool mint and gentle lavender. Eventually black pepper and rosemary begin to appear spicy. It has a long-lasting and contemporary masculine smell because the base is made woody and smooth with ambroxan, vetiver and tonka bean.

products.title: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum is a masculine woody aromatic fragrance from the house of Armaf. It starts with a burst of citrus freshness from bergamot, pomelo, mandarin, orange and lemon and in the middle notes, a floral twist with lavender, geranium, tuberose and ylang-ylang then balances freshness with elegance. The final notes end in a warm and spicy trail of black pepper and cardamom, creating a bold yet smooth finish. This fragrance is designed for men who like energetic, confident and modern scents that last throughout the day.

products.title: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, warm perfume made for both men and women. It opens with juicy and honey like notes of honey, blood orange, apricot and lemon, which give a fruity, sweet start. The heart comes creamy and tasty with coconut, caramel and soft magnolia. The dry down feels smooth and cozy with vanilla absolute, musk and sandalwood.

products.title: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum is a bold, masculine scent. Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum was released in 2023 and carries a dark, warm profile built around chestnut, spices and elemi in the opening; aromatic sage in the middle and a deep base of vanilla, leather and oud. The mixture feels creamy, slightly sweet and smoky with a strong leather tone that gives a classy yet powerful vibe.

products.title: Louis Vuitton L'Immensite Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton L’Immensité Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s perfume made for daily wear. It opens with bright citrus and ginger that feels cool and light on the skin. Then the scent moves into watery and herbal notes like rosemary, sage and soft geranium. The dry down turns warm and comforting with ambroxan, amber and a bit of labdanum, giving a soft skin-like finish.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo EDP for men is a deep smoky take on the fresh classic, opens with cool sea notes and sharp bergamot, heart brings rosemary sage geranium, base hits with incense and patchouli. Crafted by Alberto Morillas back in 2015. Fragrance fans rave about it as the grown-up version, richer, darker with that churchy incense twist, great projection sillage that turns heads.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a classic and men’s scent that mixes warm, spicy and woody notes into one elegant blend. It opens with fresh grapefruit, coriander and basil that feel clean and confident. The heart brings spicy touches of cardamom, ginger and a hint of orange blossom. The dry down is smooth and deep with amber, tobacco and cedar giving it a warm, masculine finish. It’s a perfect perfume for men who love a classy, charming scent that lasts through the day.

products.title: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Bvlgari. Released in 2014, it carries a rich oriental floral DNA that is strong yet smooth. The perfume opens with spicy warmth blended with sweet rum and smoky tobacco. In the heart, the scent moves into leathery tones mixed with iris and tuberose. The dry down is deep with creamy tonka bean, smoky guaiac wood, and resinous benzoin, making it dark, masculine, and lasting.

products.title: Riiffs Wonder of Your Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Wonder of Your Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy and slightly sweet scent from Riiffs house. It is a men’s perfume for those who like strong yet smooth scents that make them feel stylish and confident. The scent opens spicy and warm with chestnut, pink pepper and clove, then becomes soft and aromatic with sage and light amber and finally settles into a creamy, sweet base of tonka bean and vanilla.

products.title: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a bright and citrus scent crafted for women who love sweet, creamy and sparkling fragrances which is launched in 2025 it brings together a combination of zesty lemon and bergamot with smooth vanilla and white flowers at the opening. The middle shines with notes of rum, sugar, orange blossom, honey and whipped cream giving it a delicious dessert like feel. The final notes are caramel, tonka, musk and creamy vanilla wrapping the scent into a long-lasting sweet trail that feels both joyful and addictive.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Parfume is a rich and confident, warm and deep scent of a man's perfume. It begins with a spicy hint of pink pepper blended with fresh mandarin, which is a bright yet strong start. Lavender, sage, and cinnamon gradually enter and smooth out the fragrance and put a somewhat sweet touch on it. The chestnut, vanilla and leather base is long-lasting, creamy, and warm. This perfume seems contemporary, robust, and suitable for men who adopt strong scents.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum is a rich and classy perfume for men from the famous house of Lattafa. It opens with a bright, spicy touch of grapefruit, pink pepper and cardamom. The middle mixes soft tuberose with warm solar notes and herbal artemisia. The dry down is deep and comforting, filled with amber, leather, labdanum and smooth cashmeran.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Universe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Universe is a new female and male citrus aromatic perfume. This is a new fragrance. The Art of Universe was introduced in 2025. The aroma starts with fresh mandarin, bergamot, mint and a spicy touch of ginger. Pear and orange blossom are used in the heart to add some soft sweetness and smoothness. Musk, amber and cedar base provide a warm woody finish which remains well-behaved on the skin hours later.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum is a lavish, warm, and sweet fragrance suitable for both genders. The perfume starts with a bold tobacco leaf aroma blended with gentle spices that provide a luxurious and sophisticated feel. After a while, the creamy vanilla, cacao, and tonka bean add sweetness and smoothness to the scent. The woody and dried fruit notes remain on the skin for an extended period in the dry-down stage. This perfume exudes luxury, and daring, and is just right for those who appreciate the strong and warm scents.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Kobra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Kobra Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern fragrance for men from the well known Rasasi perfume house. Launched in 2025, this scent follows an oriental woody style that feels fresh, spicy and slightly warm at once. The fragrance opens with bright, energetic notes of ginger, bergamot and tangerine, offering a fresh citrus start. In the middle, warm cinnamon mixes with green tea and neroli to add a soft, spicy and clean feel. The base settles into a smooth blend of musk, woody notes and amber, giving the scent a warm, masculine finish that lasts for hours.

products.title: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume that is smooth and slightly creamy. It begins with a sweet spicy saffron and juicy red fruits then gradually switches to a rich tonka bean, rose and chocolate heart that is warm and deep. The musky and amber base remains on the skin for long hours with a soft and noticeable mark. It is contemporary, daring and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L’Eau D’Issey Pour Homme is a fresh, clean, and uplifting perfume for men with a gentle woody touch. It opens with bright citrus notes like yuzu, lemon, mandarin and bergamot that feel very crisp and refreshing. The middle brings a combination of spicy nutmeg, saffron, cinnamon and soft florals like blue lotus and lily-of-the-valley that give a smooth balance. As it dries down, it turns warm, woody and a bit musky with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, amber and a soft tobacco note. It is a timeless, everyday fragrance that feels light, natural and very easy to wear.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum is a classy and confident men’s scent that speaks style and strength. It was launched in 2016 by Alfred Dunhill, a brand known for luxury and refinement. The fragrance opens with fresh and bright top notes of cardamom, bitter orange, bergamot and lime. In the middle, the warm heart reveals vetiver, black pepper, blue sage and juniper which give a spicy and clean charm. The dry down is smooth with base notes of ebony, sandalwood, suede and labdanum giving it a deep and masculine finish.

products.title: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum is a fresh and airy unisex perfume from the house of Nusuk. It was introduced in 2025 and has a light, cool and refreshing clean aquatic style. The fragrance begins with the fresh and luminous scent of lemon and bergamot. Heart mixes sage, geranium and ozonic notes, which are breezy and herbal to some extent. The base settles into soft moss, musk and light amber, creating a smooth and relaxing finish that stays gentle on skin and pleasant in the air.

products.title: Lattafa Petra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Petra Eau de Perrier by Lattafa Perfumes is a creamy and sweet unisex perfume that is warm and a tad bit boozy. The initial spray introduces the splendid rum and juicy plum, which add a dark fruity touch to this spray. Then there comes tuberose and coconut, and it is soft and creamy. The smooth sweet finish of vanilla, musk and praline in the base remains hours long.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. Launched in 2023, it opens with a juicy and fruity burst of grapefruit, tangerine, strawberry and pineapple. The middle notes is floral with jasmine, orchid, peony and a touch of vanilla. Finally, it develops into a warm and luxurious base of oakmoss, musk and woody notes, leaving a smooth and lasting scent suitable for all events.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu Eau De Parfum is a refined fragrance that infuses woody and fresh notes. This is a perfect example of balance between warmth of woods and energy of the sea. Perfumer Alberto Morillas created this scent in 2018. He is a master perfumer who has been working with Acqua di Gio since 1996. This marine-woody scent also infuses fruity notes, presenting a unique masculine mixture of marine aromas with patchouli. It celebrates a vital, natural sensuality. The best part is that it combines the fragrances of the Sea Notes, Bergamot, pear, Apple, Grapefruit, Lemon, Lavender, Rosemary, Geranium, Woody notes, Tinka Bean, Amberwood, Patchaiu and Labdanum.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum is a creamy and deep scent built around the beauty of the Taif rose. It opens slightly spicy and fruity, giving a warm and interesting start. As it settles, the middle becomes more floral with soft sweetness from rose and saffron. The base feels woody, resinous, and smooth, making the fragrance feel luxurious and long lasting. Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum has a strong Middle Eastern touch but still feels modern and wearable.

products.title: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum is a new unisex floral scent from Nusuk Fragrances. Released in 2025, it offers a soft, fruity floral style, with light smoky and musky tones. The opening starts with incense, fennel, and sweet red fruits, giving a slightly warm and juicy feel. The heart blooms with peach, osmanthus and jasmine, which smells smooth and floral. The base settles into sandalwood, rose, and musk that feels creamy, gentle and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. It combines fresh, floral and woody notes that are very pleasant and have a long-lasting effect at the same time. The perfume starts with fruity and soft floral notes of apple, litchi and rose, which make a sweet and bright opening. As it develops, the heart reveals plum and jasmine that add a creamy floral depth. The base brings warm notes of moss, vanilla and patchouli, leaving a rich, elegant trail that remains for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nebras Elixir by Lattafa is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Nebras Elixir was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Nanako Ogi. Top notes are Milk Candy and Whipped Cream; middle notes are Sugar Cane and Heliotrope; base notes are Vanilla, Ambroxan and Musk.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume from the house of Swiss Arabian. The perfume has a very deep Middle Eastern oud style with a slight and soft sweet note. The opening of the fragrance is that of warm saffron, then the main note of strong oud and rose takes over and finally a very rich and creamy base of praline, vanilla and oud.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum is a deep, warm and bold unisex scent from the house of Lattafa. It mixes smoky incense, rich leather, strong oud, warm amber and soft musk into a thick, dark cloud of sweet, smoky woods. The scent opens with a hint of citrus that feels bright for a few seconds but quickly melts into spicy cinnamon, heavy oud, and warm amber. It is known for its dark and powerful aura, making it a perfect pick for people who love strong Arabic-style perfumes.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: The Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant and strong perfume suitable for both genders. The perfume has a very fruity, fresh and lively opening of pineapple, lemon and bergamot, mixed with a delicate sweetness of caramel. Gradually it transforms to a woody and mild spicy smell, and finally it is deep, warm, and smooth with amber, leather and vanilla. The fragrance has an aura of elegance, daring, and persistence.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SILVERSHADE HOMME Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic body spray designed for men who value invigorating freshness and modern style. This dynamic fresh deodorant opens with an uplifting blend of citrus and fruity notes, instantly energising your senses. The heart reveals aromatic florals paired with cool spices, adding a sophisticated layer. A base of soft woods and musk ensures a smooth, lasting finish that feels clean and assured.

products.title: Bvlgari Wood Essence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum is a bold, refreshing, and modern fragrance crafted for the urban man who never loses his connection to nature. It beautifully blends strong woody notes with fresh citrus and earthy green tones, making it perfect for men who are grounded yet ambitious.

Inspired by the harmony between nature and city life, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence gives off the feeling of a calm forest breeze in the middle of a city. It’s rich, smooth, and vibrant, a perfect choice for men who want their fragrance to be fresh but also deep and masculine.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum is a new fragrance for men and women released in 2024. It is a sweet, warm fragrance that feels playful at first and then turns rich and deep as it settles. It opens with caramel, apricot, almond and a little pink pepper spark. In the heart you get honey, soft white flowers, rose and a touch of rhubarb. The base is warm and cozy with leather, vanilla, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

products.title: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is a bold, powerful, and intense fragrance crafted especially for the modern gentleman. Launched in 2024, Bvlgari Man in Black parfum is a deeper and richer version of the original Man in Black line by Bvlgari. It opens with a smoky spice that immediately catches attention, followed by warm leather, deep resins, and creamy vanilla. This fragrance is designed for men who want to leave a lasting impression with a scent that feels both luxurious and masculine. Whether you’re heading to a formal evening or a winter brunch, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is your perfect statement fragrance.

products.title: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich oriental floral perfume designed for women who love warm and sweet scents. The perfume opens with a soft and fruity mixture of Mandarin Orange and Pear, then the heart of Jasmine, Rose, and sweet notes wrap the fragrance giving it a smooth and creamy touch. The base is Vanilla, Musk, and Raspberry that impart a warm sweetness which is very beautifully intimate with the skin.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum is a bold oriental-woody fragrance made for men who love strong, deep, and daring scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume mixes fiery spices, rich cacao, earthy patchouli, and smoky incense into a daring yet classy blend. The fragrance opens with sharp freshness from bergamot and ginger, quickly moving into warm plum, clary sage, and exotic davana at the heart. The dry down is rich and intense with tonka bean, cacao, labdanum, patchouli, incense, and vetiver, leaving a lasting powerful trail.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum from French Avenue Fragrances is a fresh, bright and easy to wear perfume for women who enjoy clean, fruity scents. This perfume was introduced in 2024 and starts with sticky sweet citrus that is fresh and joyful. The heart adds a soft green, fruity touch, while the base settles into a smooth, musky finish. French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum feels light, modern and perfect for daily wear without being heavy or loud.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Layton Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The fragrance Parfums De Marly Layton Eau De Parfum is a fresh and rich perfume with a little touch of sweetness that gives a classy and smooth feeling. The fragrance begins with an appealing combination of apple, lavender, and citrus that is very much like clean and bright. The whole palette of notes is huge, and at first, it is floral, soft and elegant, but slowly it is giving its way to the vanilla and woody notes that are now warm and deep. The scent is luxurious, self-assured, and extremely delightful, and it would be just right for those men who love the combination of fresh and sweet perfumes.

products.title: Lalique Encre Noire Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Encre Noire Lalique EDP for men is a dark, woody, and mysterious fragrance that is perfect for evening and special occasions. It opens with a fresh and green cypress note, followed by a heart of smooth vetiver, and settles into a rich, warm base of cashmere wood and musk. Created by Nathalie Lorson in 2006, this fragrance is loved for its deep, masculine aroma and long-lasting scent.

products.title: French Avenue Zenith Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Zenith Blue Eau de Parfum is French Avenue's take on Dior Sauvage EDT, built on the same fresh-peppery, ambroxan-heavy blueprint. The real selling point: it's composed by Jean-Louis Sieuzac, the nose behind Fahrenheit and Kouros. Not a generic lab copy. Clean and sharp, more functional than flashy. Works year-round, leans daytime, and fits comfortably in an office rotation.

products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum is a creamy and smooth unisex fragrance launched in 2023. It opens with a bold mix of cognac, cinnamon and plum that feels deep and slightly sweet. The heart brings soft iris with smoky myrrh, giving the perfume a calm and royal touch. When it settles, vanilla, tonka and sandalwood form a creamy and woody base that lingers near the skin and is highly elegant. French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum is ideal if you prefer comfortable, luxurious and contemporary perfumes which seem luxurious but not too loud.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette is a fresh, sporty men’s perfume from Nautica Fragrances. It is a clean ocean style scent made with sea notes, citrus and sea salt in the opening; apple, geranium, palm leaf and green pepper in the middle; and musk, vetiver, patchouli and Brazilian redwood in the base. The smell feels fresh, salty, green and a little woody, giving a cool beach day vibe that is easy to wear and not heavy.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn is a unisex fruity-aquatic Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It is a vibrant Middle Eastern summer captured in a blend of scents. The playful fruity notes of melon and fruits mixed with sea salt give it its iconic flavor. The musky heart with sandalwood and amber at the base gives it a smooth and lingering drydown.

products.title: Moschino Toy Boy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Moschino Toy Boy Eau De Parfum is a bold and modern men’s perfume from the designer house of Moschino. It comes with a fresh spicy opening that slowly turns warm and woody. The scent feels playful, classy and a bit edgy at the same time. Pink pepper and pear make a sharp and fresh beginning, whereas rose and spices add richness to the middle. The end is smooth, woody and a little sweet, which nicely lingers on the skin.

products.title: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum is a warm, bright and spicy unisex scent that mixes sweet florals with fresh citrus and deep musky notes. The scent opens strong with saffron, ginger, mandarin and bergamot, giving a bold and shiny start. In the middle, you get amberwood, Moroccan rose, Egyptian jasmine and patchouli leaf that add a soft but rich touch. The dry down of vanilla, white musk, sandalwood and oakmoss makes the perfume smooth, creamy and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Fire on Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fire On Ice Lattafa Perfumes is an Oriental Vanilla perfume for both men and women. This is a new fragrance. Fire On Ice was launched in 2025. Lattafa Fire On Ice Eau de Parfum is an aggressive, cozy and slightly sweet fragrance that makes the perfume feel rich immediately after spraying it. The fruity and spicy kick is brought out by the opening of cognac, raspberry and cinnamon. Some time later, soft rose petals and creamy caramel begin to appear and give it sweetness. The depth, warmth and powerful lasting power are provided by oak, myrrh, cedarwood and ambroxan in the base. It is warm, rich and comfortable to wear in the evening.

products.title: French Avenue Lumiere Garcon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Lumiere Garcon Eau de Parfum is a modern oriental fragrance made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, this scent feels warm, spicy and slightly sweet from the very first spray. It opens with fresh spice and green notes, slowly turning creamy and deep as it settles on the skin. The mix of pepper, herbs, soft fruits and smoky woods base gives it a classy yet relaxed feel.

products.title: Hermes Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Terre D’Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum is a rich, earthy, and fresh men’s fragrance that brings a deeper twist to the classic Terre d’Hermes. It opens with sharp citrus from bergamot, grapefruit, and lemon that feels bright and clean. The middle adds a spicy kick of Sichuan pepper with a soft touch of geranium. The base is warm, deep, and very earthy with strong vetiver, olibanum, patchouli, and amberwood. This scent feels elegant, powerful, and grounded, perfect for men who like a natural and mature aroma.

products.title: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Drakkar Noir is a classic men’s fragrance with a bold, fresh, and clean scent. It opens with sharp citrus and herbs like lemon, lavender, and rosemary that feel very energising. Then it moves into spicy and green notes such as juniper, coriander, and jasmine that add depth. The base is warm, earthy, and masculine with oakmoss, leather, vetiver, fir, and patchouli. It is a timeless scent that many men use for daily wear, evenings, and even gym days because it smells confident and strong.

products.title: Afnan Lynked Freedom  Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Lynked Freedom Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold scent for men who like clean yet strong fragrances. It opens with bright citrus notes and slowly turns into a spicy and aromatic feel. The dry down is warm and slightly sweet with a smooth woody touch. Afnan Lynked Freedom Eau de Parfum feels modern, stylish, and easy to wear in daily life.

products.title: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum is a strong and dominant perfume for men with warm, fruity, and deep notes. The introduction is a pleasant fruity mix that is infused with rose and saffron to produce a smooth but slightly spicy taste. The robust oud evolves over time with patchouli and benzoin in order to establish a complex, dark atmosphere. The bottom part of the combines leather and wood materials with soft fabrics and creates a long-lasting and powerful smell that comprises vanilla and amber.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum is a captivating, luxurious, and warm men's scent with a mellow almond top note that is mixed with spices, lavender, bergamot, rosemary, and thyme. The middle consists of cherries, vanilla, incense, and soft rose. The base note is of very leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood. This perfume is known for its sweetness-woodiness balance that has a lasting and elegant feel on the skin. It has earned a special place among the fragrance community for its powerful projection, velvety blending of different notes, and sophisticated gentlemanly vibe.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. It mixes fruity, green and warm amber notes to create a modern everyday scent. The opening feels juicy and bright with bergamot, green notes and mandarin orange. The heart becomes sweet and tropical with melon, black currant and pineapple mixed with smooth amber. The base is soft and creamy with musk, petitgrain, galbanum and vanilla, giving a long lasting finish.

products.title: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Silver Eau de Parfum is a clean, confident, fresh, and classy fragrance for men. It starts with rosemary, petitgrain and a bit of pepper that provides a sharp and green beginning. Neroli, orris and jasmine are employed in the middle to bring about a floral smoothness. Its earthy, long-lasting and woody smell is contributed by the bottom of cedar, vetiver and patchouli. It is contemporary, clean and suitable in every day use.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and spicy fragrance for men and women that opens with juicy fruits and fresh florals. It blends watermelon, pineapple, pink pepper and jasmine at the top. The middle brings herbal notes, soft lavender, sage and a light touch of cinnamon. The dry down becomes cozy with vanilla, musk, sandalwood, chestnut, vetiver, strawberry and tonka bean.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Malibu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Malibu Eau de Parfum is a fresh aromatic fragrance made for both men and women. It was launched in 2025 as a bright, tropical twist on the Hawas line. The scent opens with juicy, fruity notes of pineapple, orange and grapefruit, giving it a fresh, lively start. In the middle, warm amber blends softly with powdery orris and clean lavender, which adds a smooth aromatic feel. The base dries down to a warm, slightly sweet blend of tonka bean, musk, patchouli and cashmeran.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2022, it is a refreshing and warm scent with a perfect summer vibe. The scent has a bright and fresh opening formed by the very top notes of saffron, mandarin orange, incense and cypriol. The fragrance then gets warmer and sweeter thanks to the middle notes of rose, cashmere wood, caramel, amber and patchouli. The skin is then treated with a long lasting, rich and smooth trail created by the base of oud, leather, musk, oakmoss and vetiver.

products.title: Rayhaan Nocturno Elixir Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Nocturno Elixir Pour Homme is Rayhaan's oriental woody take on Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif, built around the same inky, incense-laced depth. This is the reformulated Midnight Blue version, not the discontinued burgundy bottle. Darker and more resinous, with incense woven through the mid rather than only in the base. More brooding than versatile. Best for autumn evenings, date nights, and formal occasions after sunset.

products.title: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum For Men is a strong aromatic perfume, which is fresh, spicy and warm simultaneously. It starts bright with bergamot and pepper that have a sharp and clean feel. Lavender and cinnamon creep in slowly, bringing the cool comfort. During the dry down, tonka bean and sandalwood render it creamy and a little sweet. It reeks contemporary, powerful, and assertive, an ideal smell to men who appreciate audacious but refined fragrances.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh aromatic scent for men who like clean, bold, and stylish perfumes. Released in 2025, it opens with spicy, crisp tones of Sichuan pepper, green apple and tobacco that feel energetic and modern. The heart brings soft violet, patchouli and cacao, which add a smooth and slightly sweet depth. The base settles into warm Madagascar vanilla, leather and labdanum, giving a creamy, masculine finish that feels classy yet easy to wear daily.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Rue Broca Theoreme Matrix Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Theoreme Matrix Eau de Parfum is a men's woody-spicy perfume released in 2024. It is pineapple, bergamot, grapefruit, and black currant, fresh and fruity, with a sharp, juicy first note. It settles down with patchouli and lavender to give it a deeper look, cedar and jasmine to give it a smooth touch. It is warm, strong, and long-lasting as the base is full of oakmoss, saffron, woods and musk.

products.title: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum is a stylish and modern scent made for confident men. Launched in 2024, it opens with a clean, fresh touch of Juniper Berries, Iris and Cypress, which give it a cool and classy start. The middle adds Myrrh and Patchouli which offer a smooth and deep warmth. And the base combination of Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Leather provides a strong, masculine and comforting finish.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that mixes floral, fruity and warm oriental notes. The opening consists of red berries, peach and bergamot that are very sweet and juicy so they create a fresh and playful start. The heart reveals soft blossom of jasmine, peony and red lily. Then, the base of sandalwood, vanilla flower and musk create a creamy and warm dry-down that is become smart and long-lasting.

products.title: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal Scents. This perfume is all about smooth musk blended with gentle floral and warm amber tones. It opens with a fresh and calming touch of lily of the valley, giving a clean and airy feel. As it settles, creamy musk takes over and stays close to the skin, making it comforting and classy. The warm amber and extra musk in the base contribute to the longevity of the fragrance and create a cozy feeling around it.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern version of the classic Cool Water scent. It combines nature and strength with a clean, green and bold feel. The perfume starts with cool notes of galbanum and rosemary, giving a fresh and natural vibe. As it settles, Haitian vetiver adds a warm, earthy touch that feels smooth and lasting. Simple yet confident, this is the perfect perfume for men who like to feel refreshed, energetic and alive every day.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, classy, and mysterious fragrance for men and women who love bold and spicy scents. This perfume opens with a fresh touch of bergamot, violet, and spruce that adds a green, crisp feel. As the scent settles, you get warm notes of leather, pine tree, and lavender, which bring a smooth, deep vibe. The base of patchouli and labdanum adds richness and makes this fragrance last long.

Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum feels powerful yet elegant, perfect for evening wear, parties, or when you want to feel confident and stylish. It leaves a warm, spicy trail that gets you compliments wherever you go.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette is a warm, woody, and fresh men’s fragrance that feels smooth and classy. It opens with a juicy combination of apple, bergamot and lime that gives a sharp bright start. Soon, the scent turns softer with orange blossom and teak wood, giving it a sweet woody middle. In the dry down, vanilla, patchouli and musk add a warm creamy finish that feels very comforting. It is simple, elegant, and a perfect everyday scent that feels clean and confident.

products.title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Metallic Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Metallic Musk Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Viktor & Rolf. It is a new launch in 2025 and comes with a strong, spicy and musky feel that makes it stand out. This perfume opens fresh and slightly sharp, with aldehydes and citrusy bergamot and black pepper for a spicy kick. After some time, it turns warm with cinnamon and lavender, giving a soft, smooth feel. In the drydown, it becomes deep and sensual with musk, leather and labdanum, giving a clean yet masculine finish.

products.title: French Avenue Royal Blend Nero Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Nero Extrait de Parfum is a bold, warm and spicy unisex fragrance made for people who like strong and wealthy scents. It opens with a fresh yet spicy mix of nutmeg, apple and bergamot that feels smooth and classy. The middle brings heat and depth with cinnamon, dry woods and saffron, giving it a dark, royal touch. The base is sweet, creamy and long lasting with vanilla, tonka bean, benzoin and musk.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette is a cheerful, fresh, fun and lively women’s fragrance that literally encapsulates summer. Light Blue opens bright and transparent with a shocking burst of Sicilian lemon, Granny Smith apple, cedar, and soft bellflower akin to the scent of an early cool morning soft breeze; incredibly pleasant! Light Blue has a slight playful nature, while bamboo, jasmine, and rose enhance its buoyancy and elegance. Light Blue dries down smooth and enjoyable with cedarwood, clean musk, and a gentle bit of amber, leaving a subtle but long-lasting impression on your skin.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: The Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette is a fragrance for men that has a fresh, woody, and slightly spicy scent, and it is modern at the same time. The very first notes of the fragrance are an appealing combination of juicy red apple, cardamom, and bergamot, which are thoroughly delightful and full of liveliness. The heart of the fragrance is clean and very aromatic; it is composed of lavender, geranium, and sage. The base notes are tobacco leaf, patchouli, and vetiver that provide warmth and depth to the fragrance. The fragrance mainly reflects a fashionably young and daring personality, thus making it suitable for everyday wear and informal gatherings.

products.title: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Intense Café Eau De Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex scent that merges smooth coffee, soft rose and creamy vanilla. It was launched in 2013 and has that calm café vibe with a touch of sweetness and a gentle musky base.

products.title: French Avenue Atlantis Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Atlantis Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, juicy and slightly creamy aquatic fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2025. It opens with a bright mix of orange, mandarin and lemon, giving a very refreshing citrus burst. As it settles, watermelon and coconut add a sweet and watery tropical feel. In the dry down, cacao, ambergris and amberwood create a soft, warm and slightly creamy finish that stays on skin nicely.

products.title: Ajmal Sacrifice Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal Sacrifice II Perfume Deodorant for Men is a captivating fragrance that embodies strength, elegance, and a modern sense of masculinity. This 200ml deodorant offers a long-lasting scent experience, keeping you feeling fresh and confident throughout your day.

products.title: Azzaro  Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum is a powerful and fashionable perfume that is deep, bold, and contemporary men perfume. It starts with a plump touch of raspberry blended with fresh green mandarin and bergamot and it has a slightly sweet fresh start. Warm spices and soft lavender trickle out slowly and the smell becomes smooth and manly. The leather bottom is opulent and strong, remaining in contact with skin a long time. The perfume is perfect for men who prefer bold and strong smells.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette is a fresh, warm, and slightly sweet men's fragrance that mixes marine notes with creamy vanilla. It opens with cool mint and soft watery notes that feel clean and refreshing. The middle brings a strong sea note, giving that salty ocean vibe. When it dries down, the vanilla and ambergris make the scent warm, inviting, and a bit sensual. It is a simple but charming everyday fragrance that many men enjoy for its freshness and comfort.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum for Men is a delightful fragrance that masterfully communicates the spicy and sweet notes in its own classy way. The first impression consists of black pepper, lavender, and bergamot, which provide the freshness, after which the heart notes of orris, cloves, and cinnamon give the warmth. The base consists of the very deep and sophisticated notes of black vanilla husk, tolu balsam, tonka bean, benzoin, and patchouli.

products.title: Ajmal Cyan Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Cyan Oud Eau de Parfum is the Dubai-based house's fruity-musky take on Xerjoff's Erba Pura. Bright citrus up front, a juicy mango-peach middle, and a clean vanilla-musk landing. Despite the name, there is no oud here. Light, sweet, and easy to wear, it feels more like a fruit bowl than a prayer hall. Built for Indian summers, office hours, and casual daytime.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor Eau de Parfum is a rich and warm fragrance that feels spicy, slightly sweet and deep. The scent opens with cardamom, nutmeg and saffron, giving a bold spicy start that quickly grabs attention. After some time, fig, iris and vetiver appear in the heart, which adds a smooth and slightly earthy feel. As it settles, leather, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli create a warm, creamy base that stays on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum is a hot and sweet unisex perfume, which is deep and somewhat smoky. It starts by flavouring a fruity apple shisha touch blended with soft pink pepper, which is a very sweet beginning but a little spicy. Tobacco, cinnamon and dates are used in the middle to form a very rich and warm feel. The oud smoke, caramel, vanilla and patchouli base make it smooth, dark and long-lasting. It is daring, contemporary and fits better in cooler seasons.

products.title: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfume is a fresh and smooth citrus perfume that is applied by women and men. The initial spray is a cool blend of bergamot, lavender and mint that is refreshing and invigorating. It has slow, soft, fruity, and flowery notes coming in slowly, giving it a touch of light sweetness. Woody notes, powdery accords and incense form a cool, slightly smoky, enduring finish that lingers on the skin hours later in the dry down. It is contemporary, stylish, and comfortable to put on at all times.

products.title: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Adorn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Adorn Eau de Parfum is a smooth, modern unisex scent. It was released in 2024 and begins with a new spicy and citrus blend of pink pepper, coriander, mandarin and violet that is bright and a little sweet. The middle is a woody, earthy touch of patchouli, cedar and oakmoss, which gives it depth and richness. The base settles into warm ambergris, benzoin and vanilla, and the drydown is soft and creamy, elegant, but easy to wear every day.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum is one of the most famous unisex perfumes in the world. It has this warm, sweet and airy aura that feels kind of glowing on the skin. The mixture of saffron, jasmine, amberwood, fir resin and cedar makes it smell rich, smooth and also a bit mysterious. It has a sweet woody smell with a little sparkle that stays on skin for long hours without feeling too heavy.

products.title: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is a bold, deep, and mysterious fragrance designed for the modern man who lives confidently and makes a strong impression. Launched in 2018, Azzaro Wanted By Night EDP brings a unique blend of spicy cinnamon, fresh citrus, and rich woody notes, making it a perfect scent for evenings, special events, and cooler days.

Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is intense and sensual, made for those who own the night. With its warm, spicy character and deep masculine vibe, Azzaro Wanted By Night is often described as charismatic and seductive, ideal for parties, dates, and night outs.

products.title: Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum is a fresh, confident, and magnetic fragrance for the modern man who loves adventure. This perfume is an amazing blend of fresh citrus, rich woods, and warm musk that creates a memorable scent experience. It smells like success and confidence in a bottle.

L'aventure is incredibly versatile and loved for its ability to draw compliments. It’s perfect for the man who wants a signature scent that is both energetic and elegant. One spray of Al Haramain L'aventure makes you feel ready to conquer the day, whether you're in a business meeting or on a weekend trip.

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume made for people who enjoy sweet citrus scents with a warm touch. It opens fresh and clean with lavender, bergamot and lemon, which feels bright and uplifting from the first spray. In the middle, the scent becomes soft and cozy with honey, cinnamon, jasmine and cashmeran, giving it a slightly sweet, creamy feel. The base is warm and addictive with vanilla, tobacco leaf and tonka bean.

products.title: Hugo Boss Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Hugo Boss Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense is a men's fragrance, an Oriental Spicy fragrance by Hugo Boss. In 2023, it was released and produced by Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley. It begins with frankincense and cardamom, making it smoky and spicy. Patchouli and vetiver are added to the heart, and the base is labdanum and cedar to give a deep, woody, long-lasting finish.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance launched in 2024. It takes the original Bad Boy DNA and makes it darker, richer, and more powerful. The scent opens with sharp black pepper and aromatic sage for a spicy and herbal kick. At the middle notes, you find rare truffle and smooth woody notes adding depth. The dry down has warm vanilla mixed with smoky frankincense, giving a strong and lasting impression. This is a fragrance made for men who like confidence, elegance, and strength in one bottle.

products.title: Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm, and dreamy fragrance made for women who love to feel soft and beautiful. Launched in 2024, this perfume brings together creamy vanilla with tropical coconut and delicious caramel for a scent that feels like a warm hug. The gentle touch of Palo Santo adds a hint of calm woodiness, while the base of white musk and sandalwood gives a smooth and cozy finish.

Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is perfect for women who enjoy fragrances that are sweet yet elegant. Every spray wraps you in a blissful, creamy cloud that lasts for hours and keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day long.

products.title: Neesh Haute Tobacco Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Haute Tobacco Extrait De Parfum is a bold and rich scent made for men who like deep and strong perfumes. Initially, it reveals a fresh and fruit-like aroma of pear and apple combined with spicy pink pepper and bergamot. The warm tobacco slowly enters through the middle notes, accompanied by saffron, cardamom and soft floral notes. The base notes of amber, sandalwood, vanilla and musk create a smooth and weighty sensation on the skin, imparting a refined and long-lasting effect.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Profondo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum for men is a fresh and deep ocean-inspired scent that starts with cool marine notes and bright green mandarin, moves to a soft mimosa heart, and ends with earthy patchouli and warm labdanum base. Created in 2024, it's part of the famous Acqua di Giò line, loved for its clean, lasting vibe that feels like a dive into clear blue waters. Many in the fragrance world call it a top pick for its smooth mix of notes, good throw, and easy wear that stands out without being too much.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for oud lovers. This scent opens with spicy and floral notes that feel warm and slightly sweet. As it settles, the deep oud mixes with caramel and soft woody tones, giving a smooth and addictive feel. The base is creamy and warm with vanilla and amber, which makes the fragrance feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum is the new-age scent of modern confidence. It’s a fragrance that celebrates being your true self, fresh, clean, and effortlessly stylish. Created for the man who is not afraid to show his sensitive side, this perfume beautifully combines bright citrus with a clean floral heart and a warm, woody base.

YSL Myslf is incredibly versatile and easy to wear. It’s the perfect companion for every part of your day, from a busy morning at the office to a relaxed evening with friends. A spray of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf feels like putting on your favorite crisp shirt, it gives you a boost of freshness and makes you feel put-together and ready for anything.

products.title: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum is a modern men’s perfume made for guys who like a clean, fresh and a little bit woody kind of smell. It starts with a very refreshing note of the bergamot and a gentle spicy tone. The middle notes are quite heavy due to the combination of leather and Haitian vetiver. The base contains smooth notes of ambroxan, akigalawood, patchouli leaf and a very slight touch of cacao sweetness.
